links.outcome: Lesion-level reporting accuracy across retrospective, prospective single-center, and multicenter datasets
links.effect: Lesion-level accuracy fell from 91.92% (retrospective images) to 89.07% (prospective single-center video) and 83.94% (multicenter video); clinically acceptable report rate 79.3% internal vs 83.3% external.
links.quote: Lesion-level reporting accuracies were 91.92% (95% CI: 90.58-93.25%), 89.07% (95% CI: 87.57-90.57%), and 83.94% (95% CI: 81.58-86.31%) on retrospective image and prospective single- and multi-center video datasets, respectively.

screen.reason: Evaluates a domain-specific multimodal large language model (Report-Angel) for automated generation of endoscopy draft reports using prospective cohorts/video datasets, but evaluates system performance rather than a specific deployment guardrail or organizational practice.
